oracleRisk.summary: Canonical apyUSD share conversion uses ERC4626 totalAssets, defined in the verified ApyUSD implementation as the apxUSD vault balance plus vesting.vestedAmount(). The AccessManager-restricted setVesting function can replace that price-relevant accounting dependency; _authorizeUpgrade is also restricted by the AccessManager. Issuer documentation describes offchain preferred-share and Treasury revenue converted into apxUSD and distributed on a configurable vesting schedule. No independent external price-feed quorum verifies the contributed vested amount. This is privileged internal share pricing, not oracle-free immutable asset-balance accounting. Underlying apxUSD reserve risk and destination bridge controls remain separate.

branchApplicability.rationale: The reviewed price authority computes apyUSD-to-apxUSD share conversion. It is not a borrower-collateral liquidation oracle; replacement of the vesting accounting dependency affects top-level vault NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The canonical Ethereum vault itself has active holder blacklisting, so apyUSD is Yes independently of upstream apxUSD. At Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z), proxy 0x38eeb52f0771140d10c4e9a9a72349a329fe8a6a used verified implementation 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112; paused() was false and authority() returned 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824. _update enforces ERC20DenyListUpgradable and ERC20PausableUpgradeable; checkNotDenied also applies to deposit and withdrawal paths. denyList() returned registry 0x2c271ddf484ac0386d216eb7eb9ff02d4dc0f6aa. That registry uses the same manager, getTargetFunctionRole(registry,add(address))=21, and hasRole(21,0xf9862EfC1704aC05e687f66E5cD8c130E5663cE2)=(true,0): an assigned live operator can blacklist holders. Manager-restricted setDenyList, pause and unpause remain. With census chain shares unavailable, pinned totalSupply reads measured Ethereum 108693331.6241827 at block 26224761, Base 398562.7427727262 at 52800640, BSC 843604.0285831871 at 128504833 and Solana 3989855.126703 at finalized slot 458729747. Ethereum is 95.4075% of the gross aggregate; deducting all remote supply as Ethereum bridge escrow instead gives 95.1864%, still material. Each peripheral deployment remains below 10% under either denominator. The Solana mint retained freezeAuthority 5CcTTUPtSxF1iB5d2fGR7gYHbUBHL1orwzbuZdQGJ1CG. The declared apxUSD parent and its 100% immediate reserve exposure are additional upstream links, not the cause of the direct Yes verdict. The registry operator is a Safe v1.4.1 with getThreshold()=4 and singleton 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a, rather than an unreachable contract role holder. Peripheral Base and BSC proxies retain non-zero implementation pointers and authorities, but exact local holder-control logic was not established: Base denyList() reverted, verified-source requests returned403/404. These unverified peripheral controls are disclosed rather than used to set the verdict.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626 wrapper over canonical Ethereum apxUSD. The Chainlink directory observed at 2026-10-09T10:38:09Z identifies Ethereum LockRelease pool 0x0f1bac2ea0311130da778c1ca287204338739f73 and BurnMint pools on Base, BNB Chain, and Solana. Those destination tokens represent locked Ethereum shares, so the end-to-end bridge risk tier is external-lock-mint even though remote pools burn and mint locally. Exact published pools remain Base 0xed23fc184a3fe5d12ca92ca4f5cefa640decf21d, BNB Chain 0x363332b186a4afce7a754a49f34d1543aec5e786, and Solana H8om8rLRoDiGgveP6rbdQ2irWgjzdfanSe9tdCr6FYxE. This directory review establishes route identity and pool mechanics only; it does not refresh historical controller pins, establish current authority closure, or supply runtime materiality shares. On 2026-11-22 (Ethereum blocks 26471570/26471685 and Monad blocks 124473582/124475220), Monad BurnMintTokenPool 1.6.1 0xd404a80641ba5490db15e0863d46fdd61f0b4cf7 and token 0xfd957d7e27d239da5455b82303b2f618f73a9c49 were reciprocally peer-verified against the Ethereum LockRelease pool, reconciling 99.9996% of the prior unattributed escrow residual while conserving the remaining 1.138 apyUSD in escrowResidual.

Verified BridgedApyxToken gates mint(), burn(), and burnFrom() exclusively to onlyCCIPPool under a 100,000,000 apyUSD supply cap.
